summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing completed for HERA Turni app. All 17 pytest cases passed. Frontend: admin login, shift generation (44 shifts, 5 uncovered SCOPERTO), substitution modal with 7 candidates, assign/absence, week nav, all CRUD (drivers/vehicles/routes/skills), driver read-only board with 5 personal shifts, driver blocked from admin routes (redirect to /tabellone). No blocking issues.

issues: Radix Dialog warning: missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby (accessibility a11y warning, not functional)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to SubstitutionModal to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); prefer lifespan context manager.

seed() only seeds on first-run (vehicles count > 0 short-circuit); acceptable but note driver user 'mario.rossi' is inserted OUTSIDE that gate on line 480 and would fail on 2nd startup with unique-email index — check logs before shipping. In practice DB already has him so fine, but if drivers collection wiped without users collection wipe it would 500 startup.
generate_shifts awaits _driver_can inside a list comprehension via [await ... in ...]; _driver_can is not truly async (just a bool). Cosmetic.
seed_data_creation: None — used auto-seeded demo data. Test-created entities used TEST_ prefix and were cleaned up in the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is pytest with xdist parallel workers, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env or fallback to preview URL. Covers auth, role guards, CRUD, engine constraint (presto <=3/day), substitutes+patch. Frontend testids are comprehensive and stable.
